dogecoin.text: The SEC already hates @elonmusk , and vice versa, so may be best for $BTC #bitcoin $ETH #ethereum $DOGE #dogecoin if Elon says nothing tonight? Just sayin.

When $DOGE #dogecoin hits $0 -- where it belongs -- that will mark the end of this bear market and will be the time to accumulate in your #Bitcoin $BTC #Ethereum $ETH #HODL bucket. Said differently, as long as $DOGE > $0.00, there's still excess euphoria in #crypto.

Sometimes I wonder if the inevitable crash of $DOGE -- since anything with infinite supply is definitionally worthless (like stones or seashells) -- will crash the entire #crypto space. Kinda surprised it's made it this far considering how much is minted and how frequently.
